command.simplemobmanners.renamed: /%s is now /%s: Simple Creatures was renamed to Simple Mob Manners.
jei.simplemobmanners.info.frog_bucket: No recipe. Use a water bucket on a frog to catch it; its variant, name and age ride along. Using the bucket on the ground releases it.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.1.title: Simple Mob Manners
simplemobmanners.guide.page.1: Mute mobs by type or name tag, keep named babies young, piglins ignore gold trims and tools. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.2.title: Mute mobs
simplemobmanners.guide.page.2: mutedEntities selects entity IDs. Names ending in _mute or _shhh are silent by default. Lists accept at most 64 nonempty distinct entries of at most 64 characters. Existing Vanilla silent state remains effective.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.3.title: Permanent babies (golden dandelion)
simplemobmanners.guide.page.3: Minecraft 26.3 and newer: off. Vanilla replaced the baby name tag by the golden dandelion (right-click a baby to stop it growing up), so only that works and the _baby/_small suffixes do nothing.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.4.title: Permanent babies (golden dandelion)
simplemobmanners.guide.page.4: Ports for 26.2 and 1.21.11 keep the old suffix mechanic (every 100 ticks a named baby is set back to age -24000).
simplemobmanners.guide.page.5.title: Piglin gold equipment
simplemobmanners.guide.page.5: Gold armor trims or a golden sword, spear, pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe in either hand count as safe equipment. The two switches default true. This does not prevent anger caused by attacking or opening containers.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.6.title: Bucket of Frog
simplemobmanners.guide.page.6: A water bucket used on a frog catches it like an axolotl or tadpole. Variant (shown by the bucket's colour and tooltip), name and age stay on the bucket; releasing it restores them. Found in the Tools tab after the tadpole bucket.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.7.title: Commands
simplemobmanners.guide.page.7: Permission level 2: /simplemobmanners muteSuffixes, babySuffixes and mutedEntities list/add/remove/clear; piglinsIgnoreGoldTrims and piglinsIgnoreGoldTools <true|false>.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.8.title: Commands
simplemobmanners.guide.page.8: Changes are saved to config/simplemobmanners.json. Formerly Simple Creatures: /simplecreatures still works as an alias with a hint, config/simplecreatures.json and the super-mod switch are taken over once.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simplemobmanners.guide.page.9: /simplemobmanners config shows and changes every option of config/simplemobmanners.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplemobmanners.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simplemobmanners.guide.page.10: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.11.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplemobmanners.guide.page.11: Playable alone (config/simplemobmanners.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Mob Manners".
simplemobmanners.guide.page.12.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplemobmanners.guide.page.12: On the first start the old Simple QoL settings of this sub-mod are taken over once.
simplemobmanners.guide.page.13.title: Settings
simplemobmanners.guide.page.13: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
